$description: Single source of truth for design tokens. scripts/build-tokens.mjs turns this into CSS custom properties inside a Tailwind @theme block, so the same values reach plain CSS, Tailwind utilities and Storybook.

font.mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
